finalText:
**Bigger than a simple rename, and part of it can't move.**

`account_id` shows up in 94 files across five services plus migrations and docs.

Three places must stay `account_id`:

- [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) — public wire field, frozen by the API contract
- [`docs/openapi.yaml:16`](docs/openapi.yaml:16) — same public contract, documented for clients
- [`vendor/reporting-sdk/src/schema.js:1`](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/schema.js:1) — vendored, generated, overwritten on refresh

Also don't hand-edit the 12 old migration files under `migrations/`. Add a new migration to rename the column instead.

Internal service code and `lib/audit.js` are safe to rename. Flag those three exceptions before you sign off.
